checks.command: tmp=$(mktemp -d /tmp/ao-init.XXXXXX); (cd cli && go build -o "$tmp/ao" ./cmd/ao); "$tmp/ao" init --help >"$tmp/help"; grep -Fq 'Create local AgentOps evidence directories' "$tmp/help"; grep -Fq 'does not' "$tmp/help"; grep -Fq 'install hooks, select work, or start a runtime' "$tmp/help"; work=$(mktemp -d /tmp/ao-init-work.XXXXXX); ( cd "$work" && "$tmp/ao" init >"$tmp/create" ); grep -Fq 'created' "$tmp/create"; test -d "$work/.agents/ao/verdicts/sha256"; test -d "$work/.agents/handoff"; dry=$(mktemp -d /tmp/ao-init-dry.XXXXXX); ( cd "$dry" && "$tmp/ao" --dry-run init >"$tmp/dry" ); grep -Fq 'would create' "$tmp/dry"; test ! -d "$dry/.agents"; ( cd "$dry" && "$tmp/ao" init extra >/dev/null 2>&1 ) && exit 1; true

aliases.reason: The init family declares no command aliases.

stderr.reason: init writes only to stdout on success.

tracker_selection.reason: The init family does not select a repository issue tracker.
